title: Native Arabic review of the new copy
why: The run board (statuses, gate note), the three drawn scenes (Lead chat, pull request, bilingual board) and the Lead example questions were written for RHL-11 and have not been read by a native Arabic speaker.
steps:
1. Open `/ar/` and read the run board in the hero, the Lead section, the pull request scene in the features section and the board in the Gulf section.
2. Check the status words (مخطَّط، قيد الكتابة، قيد المراجعة، تم الدمج), the gate note and the scene texts in `content/demo.json` under `ar.hero.board`, `ar.scenes` and `ar.lead.asks`.
3. Send corrections as text, or edit `content/demo.json` and run `node tools/render-pages.mjs`.

title: Set the real call-to-action address
why: Every `data-cta` button links to `#` because the booking address (mailto: or booking page) is not decided. The page marks this as a placeholder.
steps:
1. Decide the address (a `mailto:` link or a booking page URL).
2. Put it in `CTA_HREF` in `assets/js/main.js`.
3. Remove the placeholder note `cta.note` in both languages in `content/demo.json` and run `node tools/render-pages.mjs`.

title: Confirm the real prices and plan limits
why: The three plan prices (12, 24, 40 USD per user per month), the usage limits and the Gulf data-residency claim are examples marked [PLACEHOLDER] / [نص تجريبي].
steps:
1. Decide the final prices, limits and whether the data-residency claim is true.
2. Edit `pricing.plans`, `gulf.ph` and `faq.items` in both languages in `content/demo.json`.
3. Remove the placeholder tags and run `node tools/render-pages.mjs`, then rebuild `assets/css/styles.css`.
